title: Chapter 322 Undead Giant Rhinoceros
content:
Chapter 322 Undead Giant Rhinoceros

Wang Shuo came to the battlements, and the undead army was still attacking continuously.

In the distance, an undead beast with a huge horn on its head and white bone pieces on its body walked out of the undead camp.

[Undead Giant Rhino]

[Level: Level 55]

[Attack Power: 1000]

[Defense Power: 2000]

[HP: 30000]

[Skill: Savage Charge]

"Villain Charge?"

This undead giant rhino is seven or eight meters long, and the giant horn on its head alone is 2 meters long and 1 meter in diameter.

The white giant horn reflects light and looks harder than metal.

Wang Shuo panicked inexplicably.

The giant rhino ran fast, knocking away countless undead warriors along the way.

Wang Shuo looked in the direction of their collision and found that it was the gate of the city.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank suddenly.

"Jianguo, hurry! Blast the giant rhino."

Wang Shuo could only stop the giant rhino in his own way.

"Lord, they are too fast!"

Dense beads of sweat appeared on Li Jianguo's forehead. He was operating a catapult himself, but he still couldn't aim.

On the city wall, Sauron also stared at the giant rhino, and kept urging all long-range firepower to fire at the giant rhino.

But the giant rhino's defense was amazing, and the projectiles fell nearby and could not cause any damage at all.

No surprises!

The giant rhino's huge sharp horns hit the city gate, directly knocking a hole in the city gate made of steel plates.

Wang Shuo hurried to the edge of the raised horse face and just saw the city gate was broken.

"Not good."

After the giant rhino hit the city gate, it seemed to have exhausted all its strength and energy, and the bones on its body shattered.

It successfully completed its mission.

Without any command, countless ordinary skeleton warriors rushed to the city gate and rushed into the city wall.

The Burning Legion broke through a city gate before sending out its elite.

Although the city wall was like a trap, at least the first line of defense was broken.

The light curtain in the sky was also shaky, as if it would break at any time.

Although the fire had limited lethality to the undead, Sauron still ordered to pour kerosene down the city wall.

Wang Shuo had also received kerosene at the military supply department before, and according to Sauron's order, he poured a large amount of kerosene down the city wall.

"Ignite."

In an instant, the flames shot up into the sky.

For low-level undead, kerosene is still effective, but for high-level undead, they have already cultivated flames in their bodies, and the level of flames is higher than this ordinary flame, and there is no effect at all.

The whole Shanhai City was surrounded by a circle of fire.

But the undead were still fearless and continued to fight.

Wang Shuo was once again impressed by this spirit.

The undead army is really a rare and good army. They have no pain and are not afraid of death. Just these two points are enough to be called excellent.

The battle was getting intense, and both sides were already killing each other. No one cared about the military merit points.

The soldiers defending the city wall had been replaced wave after wave.

Some lords, who brought a small number of soldiers, had been fighting on the city wall for 6 hours.

The lords who were the main generals had never left the city wall.

The number of undeads rushing into the city wall was increasing.

At the critical moment, Suo Yong put down the dragon-breaking stone above the city gate.

This 2-meter-thick, integrated stone, once put down, is difficult to open again.

The defenders would not put it down unless it was absolutely necessary, because if they wanted to lift it up, they needed to repair the city gate again, and the workload was very huge.

But as long as they could win this battle, everything would be worth it.
